components: XA transactions: starts a multi-resource write
XA transactions: owns the final decision
XA transactions: persists commit or abort
links: commit data to Participant database A
report control data to Commit coordinator
commit data to Participant database B
report control data to Commit coordinator

steps: A transaction manager assigns a global XID across resources.
Each XA resource durably prepares its local branch.
The manager records one commit or rollback decision.
On restart, in-doubt branches query or replay that XID decision.
